notes: Web search ran out for the whole session after ten searches in this part (the tool reported 200 of 200 used), so the rest was done by reading known pages directly with the kit's own User-Agent (states/net.py): the sites the candidates filed with the Secretary of State, government sites, the state DFL's endorsed list, the Minneapolis Republican Party's site and the University of Minnesota's election archive. A campaign site nobody filed could not be searched for, so a missing website here is not proof that none exists.

Out of reach and not worked around: jondorau.com (the site Jon Dorau filed) answers scripts with 403, so no website is recorded for him; bemidji.k12.mn.us fails its TLS handshake with both fetchers, so the Bemidji board page was not read (Robert P. Hagge); mncourts.gov was not requested (earlier parts found it answers 403), so no court page for Sarah S. West, the only candidate for her seat.

Diane Napper: the Minneapolis Republican Party's home page (https://www.mplsgop.org/) lists her under 'SD 63' among 'Our Candidates' with her site, but does not use the word endorsed, so no endorsed_by is recorded.
Julie Henslin: the DFL's list prints her as Julie Vossen-Henslin under House District 16B and links only a social media page from her name; no campaign website was found.

Not listed on their government's own page of current members (so no office recorded): Jim Reeder (Le Sueur County lists Danny O'Keefe for District 2), Jon Dorau (Pine County lists Matt Ludwig for District Five), Joshua R. Baird (Maple Grove), Brandon Wexler (Otsego), Kate Egelhof (Bemidji lists Josh Peterson for Ward 2), Sofi Villena (Robbinsdale lists Mia Parisian for Ward 3), Glen D. Goebel (Pine City schools), Nick Arnfelt (Delano schools), Nevin Brede (Alexandria schools). Martin County's Sheriff page names no sheriff, so nothing is recorded for Matt Owens.

Roger D. Pohlman's site also describes police and military careers; those are jobs, not offices, and are left out. Kevin M. Magnuson's site gives 2023 as the start of his elected term and no year for his appointment, so no start year is recorded.

Our record marks none of the county, city or school candidates in this part as an incumbent, while official pages show Larry Anderson, Roger D. Pohlman, Roger Tellinghuisen, Jenny Sanders, Brian Melton, Kevin Magnuson, Dan Jerzak, Andy Hjelle, Tony Reichenberger, Ken Mattson and Corey Stanger hold the offices they seek. The Secretary's list carries no incumbent mark for these offices, so this is a gap, not a contradiction, and no review items were written.
